description: This file defines an internal class 'PeriodicAction' used for executing a given action periodically based on a specified time span, with logic to determine when the next execution should occur.

classes.name: PeriodicAction
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a periodic execution of an action, tracking the next execution time and executing the action when the time has come.

methods.name: PeriodicAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the periodic action with a specified period, an action delegate, and an optional start time. Sets the next execution time accordingly.

methods.name: TryAction
methods.description: Attempts to execute the action if the current time has reached or passed the next scheduled execution time. Updates the next execution time accordingly.
